interpretation_limits: The held-out benchmark measures decision consistency and model-predicted counterfactuals, not live WebArena task success.
Only the recorded action has an observed outcome; alternative candidate outcomes remain model predictions.
The deterministic AXTree generator is active; the strict LLM/VLM adapter is implemented but no provider credential is bound.
The W0 dataset has no positive severe_failure samples in the held-out split, so that risk head remains unvalidated.
